rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.source: Rainwater Leaks and Outdoor Tiles After Rain
rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.target: 雨后渗漏与户外瓷砖处理指南

rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.source: Start with where water appears and when it happens. We assess roof, balcony and exterior wall waterproofing, and the base beneath outdoor tiles, before agreeing the repair area. A ceiling stain, cracked grout or a dry-looking tile surface is a clue, not a complete diagnosis.
rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.target: 先记录水迹出现的位置与时间。我们评估屋顶、阳台及外墙防水，以及户外瓷砖下方的基层，再商定修复区域。天花水渍、填缝开裂或看起来干燥的砖面都只是线索，不能代替完整判断。

rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.source: Record the rain pattern and affected area
rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.target: 记录降雨规律与受影响部位

rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.source: From a safe indoor or ground-level position, note when water first appears, whether wind direction matters, how long dampness persists and any previous repair in that area. Keep existing reports and photos together. Do not climb onto a wet roof to collect evidence. Keep clear of water-affected electrical equipment and arrange qualified assistance if it is affected.
rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.target: 在室内或地面安全位置，记录何时最先出现水迹、是否与风向有关、潮湿持续多久，以及该区域是否修补过。将已有报告与照片整理在一起。不要爬上湿滑屋顶取证。远离受水影响的电气设备，并请具备相应资格的人员处理。

rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.source: Tell us your suburb, building type, affected surface and whether water is still entering. Photos are optional: email safely taken images to handyman.lyric@outlook.com. Our enquiry form accepts a description; you can contact us without photographs or measurements.
rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.target: 请告知所在区域、建筑类型、受影响表面及是否仍在进水。照片不是必需资料，可将安全拍摄的照片发至 handyman.lyric@outlook.com。询盘表单可填写文字说明，没有照片或尺寸也能联系我们。

rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.source: Trace roof, wall and balcony water entry before sealing
rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.target: 密封修补前先排查屋顶、墙体与阳台进水路径

rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.source: Wind-driven rain can expose an entry path that stays dry in lighter weather. We compare the observed pattern with accessible surfaces and junctions. At a roof, previous coatings and penetrations matter; beside a window, the wall junction and adjoining building elements also need consideration. A visible indoor mark does not pinpoint the exterior entry point.
rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.target: 风雨可能暴露出小雨时不进水的路径。我们将观察规律与可安全接近的表面及节点进行比对。屋顶需考虑旧涂层与穿透部位；窗边也要考虑墙体交接与相邻构件。室内可见水渍并不能直接定位外部进水点。

rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.target: 阳台防水层与门槛处理

rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.source: For a tiled balcony leaking below, compare outlet connections, thresholds, perimeter joints and the concealed membrane. An isolated joint defect with a sound base may allow a limited repair. Failed membrane work needs its own removal, connection and reinstatement scope; adding grout does not replace that layer.
rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.target: 铺砖阳台向下渗水时，应结合排水口连接、门槛、周边接缝与隐蔽防水层排查。基层稳固、缺陷局限于单个接缝时，可考虑有限修复。失效防水层需要明确拆除、连接与恢复范围，补填缝不能代替这一层构造。

rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.source: Separate courtyard surface falls from pipe problems
rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.target: 区分庭院砖面坡度与管道问题

rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.source: A puddle on outdoor porcelain tiles may involve a low spot, the outlet height or adjoining ground levels. A clear surface grate cannot establish whether the pipe below is clear. Record where water sits, whether the outlet backs up and whether the problem follows ordinary rain as well as heavy rain.
rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.target: 户外瓷质砖面积水可能涉及低洼点、排水口高度或相邻地面高度。格栅清洁不能确认下方管道畅通。请记录积水位置、排水口是否返水，以及普通降雨和大雨时是否都会出现。

rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.source: Our tiling assessment considers the accessible base, planned falls, door levels, step edges and movement joints. Suspected stormwater pipe blockage or damage needs separate drainage assessment before retiling. A textured tile finish or new grout will not change an unsuitable fall.
rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.target: 我们的贴砖评估涉及可见基层、拟定排水坡度、门口高度、台阶边缘与活动接缝。若怀疑雨水管堵塞或损坏，应先另行评估排水，再重新铺砖。纹理砖面或新填缝无法改变不合适的坡度。

rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.unchangedReason: Reviewed company identity, contact detail or retained technical label.

rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.source: Confirm the base before covering or retiling
rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.target: 覆盖或重新铺砖前先确认基层状况

rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.source: Dry-looking tiles can conceal moisture or damaged layers below. Before covering an outdoor finish, assess whether the existing tiles are well bonded, what lies beneath and whether new finished heights leave workable thresholds and outlets. Covering loose tiles or a failed membrane can leave the original defect in place.
rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.target: 看起来干燥的瓷砖下方仍可能有潮气或受损层。覆盖户外饰面前，应评估旧砖粘结是否牢固、下方构造状况，以及新完成面高度是否能与门槛和排水口合理衔接。覆盖松动瓷砖或失效防水层，可能仍保留原来的缺陷。

rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.source: Application conditions and rain protection depend on the selected system. Drying, readiness for tiling and return to water are separate stages. We plan the programme around the base condition and product instructions, with any further repairs identified before installation.
rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.target: 施工条件与防雨保护取决于所选系统。干燥、具备铺砖条件与恢复接触水是不同阶段。我们结合基层状况和产品说明安排进度，并在安装前明确后续修复内容。
干燥、固化与恢复使用阶段

rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.source: Compare leak repairs by scope and reinstatement
rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.target: 按修复范围与恢复项目比较报价

rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.source: Compare the entry path investigated, access arrangements, removal area, base preparation and membrane boundary. For retiling, check tile supply, adhesive, grout, flexible joints, edges and waste removal. Ask which checks and handover records are included and how concealed findings will be agreed before extra work.
rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.target: 比较报价时，应核对排查的进水路径、进场安排、拆除区域、基层处理与防水边界。重新铺砖还需核对瓷砖供应、瓷砖胶、填缝、弹性接缝、边缘收口与废料处理。询问包含哪些检查与交付记录，以及发现隐蔽问题后，如何在额外工作前取得同意。

rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.source: Roof-covering, window, drainage and interior reinstatement work may involve a separate trade and scope. For insurance enquiries, keep dated photographs, observations and previous repair records; ask your insurer what documentation they require. A repair quote does not establish insurance cover or approval.
rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.target: 屋面、窗体、排水及室内饰面恢复可能涉及其他工种与独立范围。如需询问保险，请保存注明日期的照片、观察记录与既往维修资料，并向保险公司询问需要哪些文件。维修报价本身不能确认承保或批准赔付。

rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.source: Discuss the affected surface and repair sequence
rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.target: 沟通受影响表面与修复顺序

rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.source: Send your suburb, where water appears and when it happens. We confirm the relevant waterproofing or tiling assessment before agreeing the work area, materials and access.
rainwater-leaks-after-rain-guide.html/ht.target: 请发送所在区域、水迹位置与出现时间。我们先确认相关防水或贴砖评估，再商定施工区域、材料与进场条件。
